title: P1: add CPU-only repository privacy validation foundation
body:
## Summary

Starts P1 Engineering Reliability with a CPU-only, standard-library repository privacy and path-boundary validator.

## Included

- Versioned JSON report schema for repository privacy validation
- Stable P1 failure codes and remediation text
- Fail-closed checks for local profiles, artifacts, workspaces, model/DFM/checkpoint/media/archive types, credential-like filenames, and oversized non-text files
- Atomic ignored report output under `.p1-local`
- PowerShell 5.1 wrapper and Chinese BAT launcher
- Standard-library unit tests using temporary synthetic files only
- Linux and Windows GitHub Actions jobs using Python 3.12

## Safety boundary

This slice:

- does not require a GPU;
- does not import TensorFlow or DeepFaceLab;
- does not start training, extraction, merge, export, or VisoMaster;
- does not read media, checkpoint, DFM, or embedding contents;
- does not modify workspace or tracked repository files;
- uses no paid service and downloads no models.

## Local validation

```powershell
python -m unittest discover -s tests/p1 -p "test_*.py" -v

& ".\19_运行P1仓库隐私与边界检查.bat" `
    "C:\Path\To\python.exe"
```

## Next slice

After this foundation passes, add versioned P0 report-schema validation and one-command read-only acceptance summaries.
